topic: Compilation of 'High IQ moments in football' with red circle/arrow highlights explaining clever plays (free kicks, off-ball moves)
hero: Various unidentified players (no single hero); Arsenal coach/free-kick routines appear early
hook: Close-up of Arsenal coach in teal jacket reacting, then free-kick wide shot
subtitle_style: no captions except small channel watermark 'TEOCRI' top-right; 'PLAY' tag top-left in some clips
reaction_overlays: red hand-drawn circles/arrows (yellow arrow), spotlight glow, emoji eyes overlay pointing at off-ball detail
transition_summary: Hard cuts between plays with occasional zoom/blur transition; slow-ish rhythm (about 1 cut/10s detected, but clip changes every ~6-10s)
audio_note: Original commentary and crowd noise with music (transcript includes '[Music]', 'Lewandowski nearly there to profit')

reuse_segments.what: Broadcast clips of free kicks and off-ball moves with circle overlays
reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: Needs licensed match footage; recreate the red-circle/arrow explainer overlay with own edit on licensed clips
